# PCB FIX1 source register

Derived project calculations/layout changes are in `scripts/` and `docs/evidence/v1a_lite/`. Manufacturer/site copyright retained; no redistribution license asserted. Required attribution is the named owner, document identity, URL and date below. Earlier footprint/reference provenance remains in `third_party/v1a_lite_layout/`, `v1a_lite_phase_d/` and `v1a_lite_phase_c3/`.
